findings.text: a stalled row for a worker whose exit the supervisor recorded (exit.json read into process_alive false at recovery.py:3440) reads "liveness unknown" because the branch requires liveness_proven for "process gone", so a recorded death is reported as an absent reading; measured at both revisions with my exit probe (prior head "process gone, quiet 31m" against head "liveness unknown, quiet 31m", logs/probe-recorded-exit-corner.log), low severity because the recovery verb is investigate either way and section 2 defines "process gone" by the pid check alone, but the row's value is being acted on without the hand-check it replaces.

item_verdicts.diff: commit 8236dcc3 replaces the single detail expression with the three-state clause and adds the two unproven cases, and b7c1272e appends the plan landing record, the evidence anchor and the figure; I re-ran the declared three-file gate at head for 29 passed, exit 0 (logs/review-gate-head.log), and both scratch trees were restored byte-exact after the mutation pair (sha256 compared against git show).
item_verdicts.done_when: the declared done-when is met at head — the live case renders "alive, quiet 31m" and the locally-dead case "process gone, quiet 31m" with neither word in the other's line (tests/test_stalled_row_names_liveness.py:195-200 and :215-223, with liveness_proven True asserted at :217), the two unproven cases render "liveness unknown" (:241-247 and :271-274), and the pane line for the unproven case reads "liveness unknown, quiet 31m" (logs/probe-pane-line-at-head.log); the delivered module run against the prior code fails exactly on the two new liveness assertions (logs/new-cases-against-prior-code.log).
item_verdicts.goal: plan section 3 asks that every stalled row name the process state in words, and the prior finding 1 (a false "process gone" for liveness that was never established) is resolved at b7c1272e: the clause at reckon/crew/recovery.py:4884-4890 sends "alive" for alive is True, "process gone" only for a death this host proved (liveness_proven True at :4886) and "liveness unknown" otherwise, and my own read-only probes render "process gone, quiet 31m" for a pid-None pointer at 2fd5f559 against "liveness unknown, quiet 31m" for the same pointer at head (logs/probe-unproven-at-prior-head.log, logs/probe-unproven-at-head.log).
item_verdicts.manifest: the node's delivered manifest reads complete and names its four commits, the three-arm gate (base arm 2 failed/25 passed, prior code plus the new tests 2 failed/6 passed, head 29 passed exit 0) and its declared control with the restore hash; prior finding 2 (a minutes assertion that could not fail) is resolved: at head the expected minutes come from the fixture's own stream mtime (tests/test_stalled_row_names_liveness.py:105 and :200) and from the constant handed to the stub (tests/test_stall_clock_starts_at_the_attempt.py:49 and :169), so I falsified it — a one-minute shift inside _run_stream_quiet_seconds leaves the prior module green (logs/mutation-quiet-shift-prior-head.log) and reddens the head module with 4 failures (logs/mutation-quiet-shift-head.log).
item_verdicts.write_paths: git diff --name-only bf17b5a8..b7c1272e lists seven paths — reckon/crew/recovery.py, tests/test_stalled_row_names_liveness.py, tests/test_stall_clock_starts_at_the_attempt.py, the plan page, the landed evidence page and the figure's script and png — every one inside the fence section 3 declares, and the declared reckon/crew/ticker.py is untouched with its reason stated (the pane already reads the classifier's detail through its existing clause at ticker.py:1165-1183).

justifications.durability: the fix is committed at b7c1272e with its tests, the minutes assertion is now derived from the fixture's own mtime rather than from the reader (tests/test_stalled_row_names_liveness.py:105), so a reader regression reddens it as I measured, and both scratch trees were restored byte-exact.
justifications.evidence: every claim reproduced independently — the unproven render at both revisions, the pane line, the delivered tests red against the prior code, the gate re-run, and the mutation pair that falsifies the minutes assertion in the head module while the prior module stays green; nothing rests on the node's own logs alone.
justifications.fit: the new cases extend the existing shared fixture rather than inventing a parallel one, the comment at recovery.py:4871-4883 states the mechanism (three situations, one state word, opposite remedies) with no plan or ticket label, and the renderer needed no change because the detail travels inside the row the snapshot already publishes at recovery.py:4990.
justifications.goal_fidelity: both named cases and every word the plan's shared terms define are delivered and the false claim finding 1 named is gone, but a supervisor-recorded exit (exit.json read at reckon/crew/recovery.py:3440 into process_alive false) cannot reach the word "process gone" because the branch at :4886 demands liveness_proven, so a worker whose end was recorded reads "liveness unknown".
justifications.scope_discipline: all seven changed paths across bf17b5a8..b7c1272e sit inside the section 3 fence, no path outside the fence is touched, and the declared-but-untouched ticker.py is explained by the pane's existing detail clause at ticker.py:1165.
